card.title: SIBERIAN TRANSFER
card.text: Add a T-34 1942 unit to the support line. Destroy it at end of turn.
card.flavorText: At the start of the war there were a large numbers of veteran Siberian divisions defending the eastern Soviet borders against a possible attack from the Japanese . After Stalin realized that the Japanese had no intention of attacking he ordered these divisions to be transferred to the front near Moscow in the winter of 1941 and were encountered all along the front protecting the city.
